request.style: English, upbeat pop, bright female vocal, synth bass, electric piano, clean guitars, claps, punchy drums, euphoric chorus, 118 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I kept the photographs of every time I fell
I kept the receipts of every wrong, I knew them all too well
I wore my yesterday like a coat in summer heat
Then grace came walking in and set me on my feet

[Chorus]
If anyone is in Christ, there is a new creation
The old has passed away
Look, the new has come
Look, the new has come

[Verse]
Throw the curtains open, let the morning in
Every day a first day, every page begin
I don't have to carry what he carried on the cross
Everything I gave up was never any loss

[Chorus]
If anyone is in Christ, there is a new creation
The old has passed away
Look, the new has come
Look, the new has come

[Bridge]
All this is from God
Who reconciled us to himself through Christ
And gave us the ministry of reconciliation

[Outro]
Look, the new has come
Look, the new has come
